summary:
The list has 63 SF company sites. Every coordinate came from OpenStreetMap Nominatim (structured street queries, 1.1 s throttle, proper User-Agent) except Wikimedia, which I placed by hand because Nominatim only returned the street centroid. Many OSM results name the tenant (Airbnb, Stripe, Plaid, Nextdoor, Visa, Dolby, Cruise, X, LinkedIn, GitHub), which backs up those addresses.

I checked a few entries against 2026 news. Anthropic is at 500 Howard St (direct lease, about 1M sf nearby; a 300 Howard future HQ is unconfirmed). OpenAI's HQ is 1455 3rd St, and its Mission Bay campus also takes in 1515 3rd St (former Uber), 550 Terry Francois and part of Dropbox's 1800 Owens. Uber's HQ is therefore 1725 3rd St. Databricks planned its HQ move from 160 Spear to One Sansome for H2 2026; the move-in is not confirmed.

Entries flagged as moved or closed:
- X/Twitter left 1355 Market for Texas in 2024.
- Block left 1455 Market for Oakland.
- PG&E left 77 Beale for Oakland in 2022.
- Schwab's HQ is in Texas; the SF building remains.
- Cruise shut down in Dec 2024.
- GitHub closed its offices in 2023.
- Anchor Brewing closed in 2023 and was sold with plans to reopen; 2026 status not verified.
- Dropbox, Yelp, Twilio, Instacart and Webflow are remote-first.

Stripe's HQ is outside SF in South San Francisco (354 Oyster Point Blvd); the list uses its SF office at 510 Townsend. Low-confidence addresses that need checking before use: Perplexity, Sierra, Mixpanel, Benchling, Mozilla and Hims & Hers. Many addresses beyond the news-checked ones (the 'from memory' sources) come from my own knowledge plus the geocode, not from a 2026 source.

Shared buildings: 303 2nd St holds Scale AI, Reddit and DoorDash; 415 Mission holds Salesforce and Slack; 350 Bush holds Atlassian and Twitch. Nearly all sites sit within about 3 km in SoMa, the Financial District and Mission Bay; outliers are the Presidio (ILM), the Marina and Fisherman's Wharf (Ghirardelli, Williams-Sonoma) and Dogpatch. A SoMa/FiDi/Mission Bay box (37.755-37.805 lat, -122.425 to -122.385 lon) covers about 90% of them.
